title: Hadwiger-Boltyanski Illumination Conjecture
exact_target: Can the boundary of every n-dimensional convex body be illuminated using at most two to the n light directions?

sources.citation: Arman, A., Kaire, J.S., Prymak, A., 'Illumination number of 3-dimensional cap bodies', Discrete Math. 349(7) (2026); arXiv:2507.08712.
